CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_CI_Loans_Corporate] AS
BEGIN

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'CI_Loans_Corporate') 
BEGIN
   TRUNCATE TABLE  DW.CI_Loans_Corporate;
END;



WITH DimCustomerAccount_LNS AS
(
    SELECT  
     DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate ,DB.BankID 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount DCA
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DA ON DCA.AccountSK = DA.AccountSK
    LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DB ON DCA.BankSK = DB.BankSK 
    WHERE DCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND DCA.CurrentIndicator = '1' AND DB.BankID IN ('CBC01', 'CBC11')  AND DCA.Shareindicator = 'Y'
    GROUP BY DCA.AccountID ,DCA.CustomerID ,DCA.SourceSystemCode ,DCA.ValidStartDate ,DCA.CustomerSK ,DCA.BankSK ,DCA.BranchSK ,DCA.AccountSK ,DA.AccountOpenedDate,DB.BankID 
)
INSERT INTO DW.CI_Loans_Corporate
SELECT DISTINCT
    DCA.AccountID
    ,DCA.CustomerID
    ,CASE WHEN DC.GlobalCIF IS NOT NULL THEN REPLACE(DC.GlobalCIF,'Global_CIF_','Entity_CIF_')
      ELSE CONCAT('Entity_CIF_', DC.SourceSystemCode, '_', DC.CustomerID) END AS EntityCIF
    ,DC.FCBSCIF AS FCBSCIF
    ,DCA.BankID AS BankCode
    ,DBr.BranchID AS BranchCode
    ,DBr.BranchName
    ,DBr.Area
    ,DBr.Region
    ,DCA.SourceSystemCode AS Source
    ,DP.ProductGroup AS ProductGrouping
    ,DP.ProductName as ProductType
    ,CONCAT(DP.ProductGroup,'-',DP.ProductName) AS ProductDetails
    ----,DP.FcbsApplication AS Application ----This column does not exist in DIM PRODUCT
    ,DCA.AccountOpenedDate AS OpenedDate
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull AS RelationshipExposure_Full
    ,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated AS RelationshipExposure_Shared
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull AS DueForTheMonth_Full
    ,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated AS DueForTheMonth_Shared
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull AS CreditLimit_Full
    ,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated AS CreditLimit_Shared
    ,FLRE.BusinessDateSK AS BusinessDate
    ,DCA.ValidStartDate AS LastUpdatedDate
    ,CONCAT(DCA.AccountId,DCA.CustomerID,DCA.BankID,DCA.SourceSystemCode) as AccountKey    
    
FROM DimCustomerAccount_LNS DCA
JOIN (SELECT CustomerSK,FCBSCIF ,GlobalCIF,SourceSystemCode,CustomerID FROM DW.DimCustomer WHERE CustomerType = 'Corporate' AND CurrentIndicator = '1') DC ON DCA.CustomerSK = DC.CustomerSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK,ProductSK FROM DW.DimAccountProduct WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DAP ON DCA.AccountSK = DAP.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT BranchSK ,BranchID ,BranchName ,Area ,Region FROM DW.DimBranch WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DBr ON DCA.BranchSK = DBr.BranchSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ProductSK ,ProductGroup ,ProductName FROM DW.DimProduct WHERE  CurrentIndicator = '1') DP ON DAP.ProductSK = DP.ProductSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,TotalRelationshipExposureFull ,TotalRelationshipExposureProrated ,BusinessDateSK FROM DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansRelationshipExposure )) FLRE ON DCA.AccountSK = FLRE.AccountSK
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,OutstandingBalanceFull ,OutstandingBalanceProrated FROM DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansOutstandingBalance )) FLOB ON DCA.AccountSK = FLOB.AccountSK ----NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT AccountSK ,CreditLimitAmountFull ,CreditLimitAmountProrated FROM DW.FactLoansCreditLimit WHERE BusinessDateSK IN (SELECT MAX(BusinessDateSK) FROM  DW.FactLoansCreditLimit) ) FLCL ON DCA.AccountSK = FLCL.AccountSK ----NO DATA
GROUP BY
DCA.AccountID
,DCA.CustomerID
,DC.GlobalCIF
,DC.SourceSystemCode
,DC.CustomerID
,DCA.BankID
,DBr.BranchID
,DBr.BranchName
,DBr.Area
,DBr.Region
,DCA.SourceSystemCode
,DP.ProductGroup
,DP.ProductName
,DCA.AccountOpenedDate
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureFull
,FLRE.TotalRelationshipExposureProrated
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceFull
,FLOB.OutstandingBalanceProrated
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountFull
,FLCL.CreditLimitAmountProrated
,FLRE.BusinessDateSK
,DCA.ValidStartDate
,DC.FCBSCIF

END
GO
